question: What will be the Caldara–Iacoviello Geopolitical Risk Index for November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo: monthly GPR has run 126-178 in Jun-Sep 2026 (Sep 146.2) after the March Iran-war peak of 330. Mid-October daily 7-day average was 186.6, so October is likely a bit higher. November 2026 has US midterms (Nov 3), which dilute the geopolitical share of news; Nov 2025 was 104. Ongoing Iran blockade, Hormuz disruption and Russian escalation keep the floor raised compared with 2025 (avg 145). Upside tail: renewed US-Iran combat or a Russia-NATO incident. Markets: Manifold 'daily GPR>=600 in 2026' at 12% is a daily-index near-miss contract, not an anchor; no market found on the monthly value.

- Other: Israeli elections Oct 27 (Eisenkot may form a government), Brazil runoff, Ethiopia civil-war risk, US-China trade truce runs to Jan 2027 (ZeroFox).
- US midterm elections on 2026-11-03 compete for newspaper share. The prior November (2025) was the lowest month of 2025.
- Dispersion: 2-month log-change SD in monthly GPR across 2025-26 is roughly 0.2-0.25; month-to-month swings of ±30-40% are common.

calls.reasoning: Latest monthly GPR: Sept 2026 = 146.2. The 7-day average of the daily index to Oct 13 was 186.6, and the 2026 YTD average is 187.5, lifted by March's 330.2 when the US/Israel–Iran war began. There is no ceasefire. The White House said it will not strike before the Nov 3 midterms, but reporting points to a buildup aimed at major operations after that. If strikes resume in November, the analogs are March 2026 (330) and June 2025 (222), which puts the outcome at 200–330. If the standoff continues with Hormuz disrupted and Russia–Ukraine escalating, expect 140–200. Market check: no market prices this monthly value. Manifold's 'GPR ≥600 in 2026' (12%, ~2.1k volume) uses the DAILY GPRD series and any-day-in-year, so it is tail evidence only, not an anchor.

US deployed 9,000 additional sailors/Marines, aerial refueling up 50%, and Hegseth met Israeli leaders about 'resuming major military operations'. Analysts quoted expect another round of war.

Russia–Ukraine 'energy ceasefire' collapsed; 650+ drones on the Moscow region in early Oct. China running a continuous coast-guard 'quarantine' pattern around Taiwan since Jun 1.

- Analogs: months with a new major US/Israel strike campaign land at 220–330; recent months of standoff without one land at 120–190.

calls.reasoning: Sep 2026 GPR 146.2; mid-Oct daily 7-day average 186.6 in an unresolved US-Iran war (Hormuz nearly halted, blockade, no ceasefire). Midterm coverage on Nov 3 dilutes article share modestly. The key fork is renewed major US/Israeli strikes after the midterms (~30%), which would put the value at 220-330 based on Jun 2025 and Mar 2026. Without them, the standoff gives 135-180. The mixture gives a median ~166, right-skewed. No market prices the monthly value; Manifold daily>=600 is tail evidence only.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes: August value (unresolvable, immaterial since Sep 146.2 is consistent across runs); the size of the midterm dilution (judgment: Nov 2025's 104 coincided with a quiet geopolitical month, so I apply only a small drag given the active Iran war); the chance of renewed strikes in November (judgment: ~30% based on Run 3's buildup reporting vs Run 2's deal-weighing). I did no web retrieval. I take Run 2/3's dispersion and set the median between Runs 2 and 3 because the mixture implies it, not by averaging.
